text: The lab results show elevated white blood cells and protein in the urine, but the renal ultrasound appears normal. Did you experience any chills, nausea, or pain specifically when urinating?

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is interesting; the absence of dysuria makes a typical lower urinary tract infection less likely, yet the flank pain and fever suggest an upper urinary tract issue. Have you noticed any recent travel to areas with contaminated water, or do you have a history of kidney stones or immunosuppression?
